name: Heartache
overview: Scripture reveals that heartache is a profound reality faced by the righteous, yet God attentively hears their cries and delivers them from trouble. He tenderly heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds, demonstrating His compassionate care. While sorrow can break the spirit, trusting in the Lord provides a stronghold and leads to favor and understanding before God and man. The Bible also warns that following our own understanding apart from God's guidance can lead to death, highlighting the need to rely on His wisdom amid pain.
